messages:
Maxine Ortega: Hey everyone :wave: I'm Max (she/her), just started today as a Solutions Engineer in SF. I'll be at the Market St office — excited to meet y'all. I bring a stubborn sourdough starter, terrible ukulele skills, and an affinity for extra-spicy ramen. Badge arrives Monday (fingers crossed). Any must-hit lunch spots or keyboard recs? :ramen:

Jules Kim: welcome Max! :tada: hit Ramen Dojo on 7th for spice. Desk plants FTW — we have a plant swap on Fridays.

Sam Tran: welcome! If you like spicy, try Ichiraku on 3rd. Also, what size keyboard? I have a spare TKL if you want to try.

Noor (People Ops): Hi Max! Onboarding checklist sent to your email. For badge pickup, go to lobby desk and mention 'Noor' — they'll help. FYI: team lunch tomorrow 12:30 outside main kitchen, swing by.

Kai Nakamura: :wave: welcome. We have a cycling group that leaves 6:30pm Tue — if you ride, come along. Also, we love sourdough starters.

BadgeBot: Badge request updated: Maxine Ortega — status: pending. ETA: Monday morning.

Maxine Ortega: thanks everyone!! Would love to try the TKL — I'm a tenkeyless convert. Also down for the ride, though my bike is vintage so we'll see :sweat_smile:

Jules Kim: bring the starter to the plant swap and we'll judge on crumb :laughing:

Sam Tran: DM me and I'll drop the keyboard at your desk later.

Noor (People Ops): Welcome again! Office tip: the coffee machine accepts personal mugs (avoid metal lids). Also Slack ping for 'lunch' channel if you wanna join.

Kai Nakamura: FYI there's a secret taco cart Wednesday by the pier. Highly recommend.

Maxine Ortega: noted! See you all around, thanks for the warm welcome :heart:
